reuse.why: Builds a shared getFillableCategories for three actions, but parses goal_def with its own SQL + JSON.parse rather than reusing goal-template.ts's getTemplates logic, and copyPreviousMonth does not use the new selector.

duplication.why: Removes the copied SQL and income checks from setZero/set3/6/12, but copyPreviousMonth still carries its own hidden/group-hidden/income filter alongside the new template check, and goal_def parsing duplicates goal-template.ts.

placement.why: The category selection lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use it; the template lookup would sit better next to the template code.

scope.why: Folding set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg into setAllCategoriesNMonthAvg is a small adjacent cleanup; otherwise focused.

maintainability.why: Most month-wide actions now share one eligibility rule, but copyPreviousMonth applies the same rule through a separate path, so a future change must be made in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden/group_hidden/is_income checks instead of getFillableCategories; getCategoriesWithTemplates re-reads goal_def instead of using goal-template.ts template loading

disguised_duplication.where: the eligibility rule is expressed once as SQL + filter in getFillableCategories and again as per-row if checks plus templated.has in copyPreviousMonth

one_place.where: getFillableCategories serves setZero/set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg, but copyPreviousMonth decides hidden, group-hidden, income and templated on its own in server/budget/actions.ts
